# Agent Maturity Compass (AMC)

> The credit score for AI agents. Open-source framework for scoring AI agent trustworthiness from execution evidence.

## Docs
- [Getting Started](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#GETTING_STARTED)
- [Architecture](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#ARCHITECTURE_MAP)

## Install
macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://agentmaturity.co/install.sh | sh
Windows PowerShell: irm https://agentmaturity.co/install.ps1 | iex

Verify a real signed evidence bundle yourself: https://agentmaturity.co/verify.html
The installers pin a GitHub release and verify SHA-256 before execution. npm also publishes the older 1.1.1 release; the Homebrew tap is not public yet.

## Full Score
amc

## Key Concepts
- L0-L5 maturity scale based on execution evidence
- Ed25519 + Merkle tree cryptographic proof chains
- 244 default diagnostic questions across 5 trust dimensions, plus a 264-question lifecycle-expanded set
- 16 framework adapters (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.)
- Signed adapter capability receipts separate declared/effective events and controls, runtime/version proof, hook mode, and lossiness; metadata-only adapters fail closed
- 1,268 public CLI command paths
- Domain Proof Lane with amcproof artifacts for source-to-rule correctness checks
- Evidence trust tiers: SELF_REPORTED (0.4x), OBSERVED (1.0x), CRYPTOGRAPHIC (1.0x)
- 41 Industry Packs, free in the current source build with no licence, account or payment (the published 1.1.1 release still locks them): self-reported questionnaires whose content is experimental, AI-drafted until a named expert signs it; access never changes a result

## A4 Forge (preview)
- One agent from a brief to a recorded deployment in four stages: Aspire (conceptualization), Assemble (creation), Adapt (contextualization), Activate (commercialization); current source build only, off unless AMC_A4_PREVIEW=1
- Every A4 record is signed and self-reported; no A4 output says the agent is safe, correct or lawful, and approvals inside one workspace are not independent review
- [A4 Forge guide](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#A4_FORGE)
